hypotheses.claim: Engine fires Draconic Buster (discards all energy) when Corkscrew would already KO or when no reload is held, causing an energy drought and non-attacking rebuild turns.
hypotheses.direction: nonattacking_turn_rate in the turns following a Draconic Buster must stay <= baseline; Draconic must not be chosen when Corkscrew(+buff) real-damage already >= opponent active HP
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: If Draconic is blocked too hard, the deck loses its only way to punch through 300+HP exes and stalls behind a 100-190 Corkscrew wall
hypotheses.scenario: Garchomp active with exactly 2 F energy (no Neo Upper/Night Stretcher in hand), opponent active 130 HP where Corkscrew+1Roserade(=130) already KOs; engine picks display-max Draconic Buster (260), KOs, discards both energy, then has 2 empty turns rebuilding while opponent swings back.
hypotheses.pattern: board-state gate on self-harm effect + real-damage comparison Corkscrew-vs-Draconic

hypotheses.claim: The display-damage evolution heuristic deprioritizes Roserade (display 80) so Cheer On to Glory never comes online and Corkscrew stays at base 100.
hypotheses.metric: play_rate[342], bench presence of 342, power_curve (real Corkscrew damage distribution)
hypotheses.direction: by mid phase, >=1 Roserade should be in play; Corkscrew real damage should exceed 100 (buffed) in a majority of attacks
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Forcing Roserade too early diverts Poke Pad/Rare Candy/bench from the Garchomp path and slows first attack
hypotheses.pattern: prioritize evolution by ability value (buff source) not post-evo display damage

hypotheses.claim: Energy should concentrate on Garchomp; Neo Upper wasted if attached to Gible/Gabite (provides only C, cannot pay their [F] attacks), and no energy on type-dead Roserade/Roselia/Spiritomb.
hypotheses.metric: energy_attach_share[381 vs others], energy_attach_share[10 Neo Upper]
hypotheses.direction: share of energy on 381 (Garchomp) high; Neo Upper attached only when target is Stage2 Garchomp; ~0 energy on 342/341/387
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Blocking all pre-evolution attach kills the valid Gible/Gabite pre-attach that carries energy up to Garchomp
hypotheses.pattern: deck-specific feeding plan: pre-attach on Garchomp line only; Neo Upper gated to Stage2

hypotheses.claim: Deck should be attacking (Corkscrew) by ~turn 2-3; a two-Stage2+Stage1 setup risks being slow to first attack.
hypotheses.direction: first_attack_turn should be small (attack online early)
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Rushing a naked Garchomp with no Roserade/energy trades a weak first hit for tempo and exposes a 2-prize attacker
hypotheses.pattern: attack-priority balance; Rare Candy usage to compress setup

hypotheses.claim: Unconditional search (Poffin/Poke Pad/Gong) plus Corkscrew drawing to 6 accelerates deckout in grindy games (only 9 energy, thin deck).
hypotheses.direction: loss_share[deckout] should be low; search should throttle when parts assembled and deck thin
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Throttling search too early causes bricks/missing pieces, which is a worse failure than rare deckouts
hypotheses.pattern: search throttle: stop digging when parts complete AND deckCount<=K

hypotheses.claim: Type-dead Roserade/Roselia (F energy pays only colorless Spike Sting; Leaf Step uncastable) may be treated as a loaded attacker and kept active, or block the active spot.
hypotheses.direction: Roserade/Roselia should not be the attacking active; if stuck there, pivot to Garchomp
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Over-eager pivoting wastes Switch/retreat and can strand energy
hypotheses.pattern: type-aware loaded check: Grass-cost attackers with 0 Grass supply are walls not attackers

hypotheses.claim: Boss's Orders gust target selection should use real-damage and prize value (KO a benched threat / snipe a 1-prize / isolate their attacker), not a generic display-damage rule.
hypotheses.direction: gust should predominantly lead to a KO or a strategic isolation, not random benched pick
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Requiring a guaranteed KO forgoes valuable tempo gusts (isolating a fat setup Pokemon)
hypotheses.pattern: prize-EV + real-damage based gust target selection

hypotheses.claim: After the main Garchomp is KO'd (especially right after a Draconic Buster left it empty), no second attacker is loaded, so post-KO attack rate collapses.
hypotheses.direction: post_ko_attack_rate should stay high (a 2nd Garchomp or Gabite ready to swing)
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Over-investing in a 2nd loaded Garchomp before it is needed dilutes the primary attack and energy
hypotheses.pattern: 2nd Garchomp reserve loading with a cap (chain requirement)

hypotheses.claim: Draw supporters (Lillie's Determination / Judge) may fire on a completed hand and shuffle away assembled win-condition pieces, or under-fire because Corkscrew keeps hand at 6.
hypotheses.direction: Lillie/Judge should fire when hand lacks immediate action, not when a Rare Candy+Garchomp hand is held
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Blocking Lillie makes the deck brick when it genuinely needs a redraw
hypotheses.pattern: draw-supporter gate on hand-action content, not raw hand size

hypotheses.claim: Cynthia's Power Weight (+70 HP -> 400) should be attached to the attacking Garchomp before it is exposed; if the engine ignores it, Garchomp dies to 330-breaking hits it could have survived.
hypotheses.direction: Power Weight play_rate should be meaningful and land on Garchomp before the opponent's swing
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Spending the tool slot/turn on HP when a lethal is available wastes tempo
hypotheses.pattern: attach defensive tool to primary attacker pre-exposure

l2_rationale: L0 display-max heuristic deterministically triggers two deck-specific misplays: (H1) Draconic Buster spamming that self-discards all energy = catastrophic tempo collapse, and (H2) deprioritizing the Roserade buff-source evolution so Corkscrew stays at base 100. Both require state gates (real-damage comparison, ability-value evolution) unreachable at L1. L0 is already correct on abilities (harmless), energy concentration onto Garchomp, and gust firing, so L2 intervention narrows to 3 rules: Draconic gate, Roserade priority, search throttle.
